description: This source file implements the 'Display' class within the Thunder Linux namespace, managing display surfaces, buffers, and input callbacks for a compositor system on Raspberry Pi 4. It handles creation, destruction, and processing of display surfaces, including buffer management with GBM and DRM, and virtual input event handling.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: Manages display surfaces, buffer creation, and input callbacks for a compositor system on Raspberry Pi 4. Handles creation, destruction, and processing of display surfaces, including buffer management with GBM and DRM, and virtual input event handling.

methods.description: Processes all surfaces, e.g., for rendering or buffer updates.

methods.description: Increments reference count, initializes if first.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count, destroys object if count reaches zero.
